name: Children Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that becoming a child of God is a spiritual privilege granted to those who receive Christ and believe in His name, as stated in John 1:12. This identity is further defined by being led by the Spirit of God, which marks believers as sons of God according to Romans 8:14. Additionally, Galatians 3:26 emphasizes that faith in Christ Jesus is the basis for all believers being considered children of God, highlighting the centrality of faith in this divine relationship.
